title: Wedding Doves, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of loyalty, harmony and a shared journey Subtle embellishments and a timeless dove motif Inspiring quote from the Letter to the Corinthians on the obverse The coin featuring a pair of doves is a symbol of love built on trust, closeness and a shared vision of the future. It is a delicate yet meaningful keepsake that reminds us of the strength of a bond nurtured every day. Its refined form and subtle detailing make it a perfect gift for a wedding, anniversary or any special moment shared by two. May the words sealed in pure silver accompany those in love each day. Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. 1 Corinthians 13:4
